text: Education is a powerful tool to transform lives, create opportunities, and pave the way for a brighter future. However, for many, the cost of tuition can make this dream seem out of reach. Government-Funded Courses Offered at JTI Registered Training Organisation
JTI offers several government-funded courses that cater to various interests and career aspirations. Below is an overview of these programs:
1. Certificate III in Individual Support (Ageing and Disability)

**Course Overview**: This qualification prepares you to provide person-centred support to individuals in residential and community settings. You'll learn to assist clients with their daily activities, promote independence, and enhance their quality of life.

items: • Duration: Approximately 1 year, with the possibility of a shorter period depending on prior experience and study mode.
• Delivery Mode: Online, Workplace, and/or flexible delivery.
• Practical Placement: 120 hours of supervised practical placement, which JTI can help organize.
• Entry Requirements: Applicants must be over 18 years of age and satisfactorily complete a Language, Literacy, and Numeracy (LLN) assessment and Pre-Training Review.
• Career Opportunities: Personal Care Worker, Aged Care Worker, Care Service Employee, Home Care Assistant.

text: For more details, visit the Certificate III in Individual Support course page.
2. Certificate IV in Disability Support

**Course Overview**: This course equips you with the skills to empower individuals with disabilities, promoting their independence and community participation. You'll learn to develop and implement individualized support plans and work collaboratively with clients and their families.

items: • Duration: Approximately 6 months to 2 years, including class time and 120 hours of supervised work placement.
• Delivery Mode: Virtual/Blended, Workplace, Classroom-Based, Distance Learning.
• Practical Placement: 120 hours in a disability organization, with assistance from JTI in securing placements.
• Entry Requirements: Prospective students must complete an LLN assessment and a Pre-Training Interview and be at least 18 years of age.
• Career Opportunities: Disability Support Worker, Community Support Worker, Disability Carer.

text: For more details, visit the Certificate IV in Disability Support course page.
3. Diploma of Community Services

**Course Overview**: This diploma prepares you for roles in community services, focusing on case management, program coordination, and support services. You'll develop skills in advocacy, community development, and managing complex cases.

items: • Duration: 1 to 2 years.
• Delivery Mode: Online, Workplace, and/or flexible delivery.
• Practical Placement: 240 hours, which JTI can help organize.
• Entry Requirements: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and complete an LLN assessment and Pre-Training Review.
• Career Opportunities: Community Services Coordinator, Case Manager, Team Leader.

text: For more details, visit the Diploma of Community Services course page.
4. Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care

**Course Overview**: This qualification enables you to work in early childhood settings, supporting children's well-being, learning, and development. You'll learn to implement approved learning frameworks and support children's holistic development.

items: • Duration: Approximately 1 to 2 years, including 160 hours of work placement.
• Delivery Mode: Virtual/Blended, Workplace, Classroom-Based, Distance Learning.
• Practical Placement: 160 hours in a long day care environment, with assistance from JTI in securing placements.
• Entry Requirements: Applicants should be over 18 years of age and demonstrate appropriate literacy and numeracy skills.
• Career Opportunities: Early Childhood Educator, Playgroup Supervisor, Family Day Care Educator.

text: For more details, visit the Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care course page.
5. Diploma of Mental Health

**Course Overview**: This diploma provides advanced knowledge and skills to support individuals with mental health issues. You'll learn to implement recovery-oriented approaches, provide interventions, and work collaboratively with clients and healthcare professionals.

items: • Duration: 1 to 2 years.
• Delivery Mode: Online, Workplace, and/or flexible delivery.
• Practical Placement: 240 hours, which JTI can help organize.
• Entry Requirements: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and complete an LLN assessment and Pre-Training Review.
• Career Opportunities: Mental Health Worker, Community Rehabilitation Support Worker, Mental Health Outreach Worker.

text: For more details, visit the Diploma of Mental Health course page.
Benefits of Government-Funded Education
Enrolling in a government-funded course at JTI offers numerous benefits, making it an attractive option for students looking to build their future:
**1. $0 Tuition Fees**: The Victorian Government covers the tuition costs, allowing you to study without the financial burden of student loans or upfront payments.
**2. Job-Ready Skills** Our courses focus on practical training and real-world applications, ensuring you graduate ready to excel in the workforce.
**3. Career Flexibility** Explore new industries or advance in your current career without financial constraints holding you back.
**4. Recognized Qualifications** JTI’s programs are nationally and internationally recognized, enhancing your credentials and making you stand out to employers.
**5. Increased Job Opportunities** Graduating with in-demand skills opens doors to exciting career prospects in growing industries such as healthcare, education, and business.
**6. Flexible Study Options**: With online, part-time, and blended learning opportunities, you can balance study with work or personal commitments.
How to Apply?
Applying for a government-funded course at JTI is simple:
**1. Explore Courses**: Browse through Our JTI website to find a course that aligns with your career goals.
**2. Check Eligibility**: Review the eligibility criteria to ensure you qualify for funding.
**3. Submit Your Application**: Complete the online application form and provide necessary documents.
**4. Get Enrolled**: Once approved, JTI’s team will guide you through the enrollment process.

FAQs
**1. What are government-funded courses?** Government-funded courses are programs where the Victorian Government subsidizes tuition fees, making them free or low-cost for eligible students.

**2. Can I apply for a government-funded course if I already hold a qualification?** Yes, you may still qualify depending on the type and level of your existing qualification. Contact JTI for specific details about eligibility.
**3. Are JTI’s courses recognized across Australia?** Yes, all courses offered by JTI are nationally accredited, ensuring your qualifications are recognized throughout the country.
**4. What are the delivery modes for these courses?** JTI offers flexible delivery options, including online, in-person, and blended learning, so you can choose a mode that suits your lifestyle.

**5. How does JTI support students during their studies?** JTI provides personalized support, including access to trainers, student advisors, and placement coordinators who assist with practical work experience.

**6. Is practical placement mandatory for all courses?** Yes, most government-funded courses include practical placement requirements to provide hands-on experience in real-world settings. JTI helps students arrange these placements.
